architecture.mechanism: AI-based fault diagnosis using random forests combined with transient fault features to detect open-circuit faults in power electronics converters
architecture.intervention: Deploy the random forest and transient fault feature diagnostic framework onto the GMC Sierra ESC/powertrain control module's power electronics circuitry to identify and isolate open-circuit faults triggering the ESC reduced-power and harsh-shifting symptoms
architecture.expected_effect: Targeted detection and elimination of open-circuit faults in the ESC power electronics without disabling stability control or compromising transmission durability, restoring normal engine power and smooth shifting
architecture.falsification_test: If the ESC fault persists after applying the AI diagnostic and no open-circuit fault is identified in the power electronics stage, the root cause lies elsewhere (e.g., sensor or software), and the mechanism would not resolve the fault

challenge.kill_reason: the mechanism-space distinctness adjudication counts 0 materially distinct mechanism(s) (< 2, mechanism_distinctness/2.0.0) — the run generated nothing worth attacking (Art. LXXXIV, R514)
